outcome: Cord blood insulin-like growth factor (IGF)-I concentrations
Cord blood insulin-like growth factor (IGF)-II concentrations
cohort: The study included 153 matched pairs of neonates born to mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and euglycemic pregnancies, drawn from the Shanghai Birth Cohort.
finding: GDM was not associated with cord blood fetuin-A levels, but fetuin-A was negatively correlated with birth weight and birth length z-scores specifically in GDM pregnancies.
